decisions.decision: The Committee agreed to pursue a feasibility study examining three potential concepts: senior housing only; senior housing with a community center; and senior housing with a community center and town green
decisions.quote: the committee agreed that a feasibility study should examine three potential concepts: 1. senior housing only; 2. senior housing with a community center; and 3. senior housing with a community center and town green.

decisions.decision: Steven Wallace will contact firms regarding the potential feasibility study and provide the Committee with estimated costs
decisions.quote: mr. wallace agreed to contact firms regarding the potential feasibility study and provide the committee with estimated costs.

decisions.decision: The Committee will continue developing a detailed space needs document and square footage recommendation for future architectural review
decisions.quote: the committee will continue developing a detailed space needs document and square footage recommendation for future architectural review.

decisions.decision: The Committee encouraged the Teen Center and Food Pantry to investigate alternate locations and consider options for funding limited repairs to the TC Passios Building
decisions.quote: the committee encouraged the teen center and food pantry to investigate alternate locations and consider options for funding limited repairs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Preliminary cost estimate for feasibility study examining three senior housing concepts
budget_items.quote: a preliminary estimate of approximately $50,000-$75,000 was discussed.

budget_items.topic: Town Hall/Ritter Building renovation and construction costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Previous cost estimates for renovation of existing building and new construction
budget_items.quote: previous cost estimates of approximately $360-$375 per square foot for renovation and approximately $472 per square foot for new construction were discussed.

topics.resolution: Committee agreed to pursue feasibility study with three concepts; estimated cost $50,000–$75,000; Steven Wallace to contact firms
topics.quote: steven wallace presented information regarding senior housing opportunities and his experience with senior housing projects in westminster and sterling.

topics.resolution: Committee concluded building insufficient in present configuration; requires additions and/or significant modifications; detailed space needs document to continue
topics.quote: the committee concluded that the building in its present configuration is insufficient to accommodate all town functions and would require additions and/or significant modifications.

topics.resolution: No definitive commitment made regarding comprehensive repairs; Committee encouraged organizations to investigate alternate locations and funding options
topics.quote: the committee discussed whether organizations operating from the building should contribute toward limited repairs if they wish to continue operating there during the winter.
